욥기 16:2.content: I have heard many such things: miserable comforters are ye all.

욥기 16:3.content: Shall vain words have an end? or what emboldeneth thee that thou answerest?

욥기 16:4.content: I also could speak as ye do: if your soul were in my soul’s stead, I could heap up words against you, and shake mine head at you.

욥기 16:5.content: But I would strengthen you with my mouth, and the moving of my lips should asswage your grief.

욥기 16:6.content: Though I speak, my grief is not asswaged: and though I forbear, what am I eased?

욥기 16:7.content: But now he hath made me weary: thou hast made desolate all my company.

욥기 16:8.content: And thou hast filled me with wrinkles, which is a witness against me: and my leanness rising up in me beareth witness to my face.

욥기 16:9.content: He teareth me in his wrath, who hateth me: he gnasheth upon me with his teeth; mine enemy sharpeneth his eyes upon me.

욥기 16:10.content: They have gaped upon me with their mouth; they have smitten me upon the cheek reproachfully; they have gathered themselves together against me.

욥기 16:11.content: God hath delivered me to the ungodly, and turned me over into the hands of the wicked.

욥기 16:12.content: I was at ease, but he hath broken me asunder: he hath also taken me by my neck, and shaken me to pieces, and set me up for his mark.

욥기 16:13.content: His archers compass me round about, he cleaveth my reins asunder, and doth not spare; he poureth out my gall upon the ground.

욥기 16:14.content: He breaketh me with breach upon breach, he runneth upon me like a giant.

욥기 16:15.content: I have sewed sackcloth upon my skin, and defiled my horn in the dust.

욥기 16:16.content: My face is foul with weeping, and on my eyelids is the shadow of death;

욥기 16:17.content: Not for any injustice in mine hands: also my prayer is pure.

욥기 16:18.content: O earth, cover not thou my blood, and let my cry have no place.

욥기 16:19.content: Also now, behold, my witness is in heaven, and my record is on high.

욥기 16:20.content: My friends scorn me: but mine eye poureth out tears unto God.

욥기 16:21.content: O that one might plead for a man with God, as a man pleadeth for his neighbour!

욥기 16:22.content: When a few years are come, then I shall go the way whence I shall not return.
